inputs.prompt: Traditional 2D cel anime, exact source characters. The camera FIRST begins tilting upward slightly as Kimi slowly straightens her bent knees from the low crouch. Keep her ENTIRE HEAD AND HEADBAND safely inside frame throughout, with space above; also retain both boots at bottom. She rises naturally without jumping: both boots always contact stone, one heel lifts only during the following single backward step. She takes ONE short step BACK toward the chained Claude, still facing the attackers/camera. Then she raises the DARK crescent blade in her RIGHT hand in a compact upward arc. A thin smooth INDIGO floor arc starts around the altar. No blue water, no flame eruption, no levitation, no orange wood fire. Her two C-shaped blades retain exact shapes and hand assignments. Only knees/arms move; camera tracks the head smoothly up then holds, no zoom. Logs remain to sides; Claude stays restrained and unchanged.
